theater: 波茲南城與大波蘭鄉村戰線

battle.name: 大波蘭起義 (1848年)
battle.theater: 波茲南城與大波蘭鄉村戰線
battle.brief: 一八四八年一月下旬，普魯士波森省議會駁回波蘭民族訴求的消息傳到波茲南，民眾在二十三日攻入議會與市政機關，奪取軍械，內城一度易手，義軍其後轉入鄉村，靠散射與襲擊拖住普軍至數月。雷管步槍在初春的雨霧中仍能擊發，讓遠距單發精射成為可能，亦令普軍密集縱隊更易被消耗。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰方是普魯士王國與大波蘭的波蘭民族起義者。普方由國王腓特烈·威廉四世主持，內政部以波森政策為職責，軍事上由弗里德里希·馮·普費爾將軍任戰區總指揮，赫爾曼·馮·朗格爾將軍負責波茲南城區與後續清剿，駐軍以波森步兵團、波森砲兵營與新徵的波森國民警衛隊為主，四月後又自西里西亞與萊茵各省調入更多步兵團與營級砲兵。起義方以一月二十五日成立的波蘭民族委員會為政治核心，軍事上先由卡羅爾·魯熱茨基率領的義軍與波茲南國民守衛隊承擔，四月由路德維克·米耶羅斯瓦夫斯基整編為波蘭民族軍，並有來自法國、德國、義大利與波蘭流亡社群的外籍志願者加入。普魯士要求俄羅斯封鎖波森東面通往華沙公國的邊境，奧地利則在南部邊境攔截潰退隊伍；外國干預主要體現在封鎖與拒絕，而不是出兵。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Kingdom of Prussia and the Polish insurgents of Greater Poland. On the Prussian side the king was Friedrich Wilhelm IV, the Ministry of the Interior carried the Polish question, and the war in the theatre was led by the general commander Friedrich von Pfuel, while Hermann von Wrangel was responsible for the city of Posen and for the later clearance of the countryside; the garrison consisted of Posener infantry regiments, the Posener artillery battalion and the newly raised Posener Landwehr, and after April more infantry regiments and battalion guns were brought in from Silesia and the Rhineland. On the insurgent side the political centre was the Polish National Committee, founded on 25 January; the military burden was first carried by the insurgents led by Karol Różycki and by the Posen National Guard, and in April by Ludwik Mierosławski, who reorganised them into a Polish national army; foreigners from France, Germany, Italy and the Polish diaspora in exile also joined as volunteers. Prussia asked Russia to seal the eastern border of the Grand Duchy of Posen facing the Congress Kingdom of Poland, and Austria halted the retreating bands at the southern frontier: foreign involvement took the form of blockades and refusals rather than of troops.
people: 卡羅爾·魯熱茨基是起義最初的軍事核心。這位波蘭軍官出身的退伍上尉在一月二十二日率義軍攻入米沃斯托沃，隨即在交火中陣亡，義軍失去最初的指揮者。安東尼·耶熱奧拉尼接替指揮，率眾在索科沃擊敗普軍分遣隊，奪得兩門六磅野砲，成為起義最著名的一場勝利，也讓義軍第一次取得可供野戰使用的火砲。路德維克·米耶羅斯瓦夫斯基於一八四八年四月被請出山，任義軍總司令，頒布軍隊編制與紀律，試圖把鬥志高昂但裝備零散的志願者組成正規營，並計劃以正面會戰取代游擊；他在五月戰敗後離開波森，隨即赴西西里參加一八四八至四九年義大利戰事。普方普費爾以圍困與斷糧為主軸，朗格爾接手後把戰線推回鄉村，兩人皆以避免與義軍在開闊地正面對撞著稱。波蘭民族委員會與波茲南守衛隊的民眾領袖多非軍人出身，軍事決策常在委員會與前線指揮之間反覆協調。
peopleEn: Karol Różycki was the military core of the rising in its first days. A retired captain from the Polish officer corps, he led the insurgents into Miłostowo on 22 January and was killed in the fighting there, so the insurgents lost their first commander. Antoni Jeziorański took over, and on the same day his men beat a Prussian detachment at Sokołowo and captured two six-pounder field guns; that was the best known victory of the rising and it gave the insurgents their first usable field artillery. Ludwik Mierosławski was invited to take command in April 1848; he set out an order of battle and a disciplinary code, tried to turn enthusiastic but badly equipped volunteers into regular battalions, and planned to replace the war of raids with a set-piece battle. After the defeat in May he left the Grand Duchy and soon went to Sicily to fight in the Italian war of 1848 and 1849. On the Prussian side Pfuel worked mainly by blockade and by cutting supplies, and Wrangel, once he took over, pushed the fighting back into the villages; both avoided meeting the insurgents in the open. The Polish National Committee and the leaders of the Posen National Guard were mostly civilians, and military decisions had to be reconciled again and again between the committee and the commanders in the field.
kits: 本卡雷管步槍是一八四〇年式的法國雷管發火長槍，底火在雨霧中仍能可靠擊發，射程因此較火繩槍拉長，射擊精度與單發命中率都勝過舊式滑膛火繩槍。普軍步兵的制式槍械其實是德勒塞針式雷管槍，一八三九年式，彈藥為紙包，有效射程可達二百米以上，精度遠超同儕；普費爾麾下同時配有一八四二年式雷管步槍與騎槍，並有少量螺管後膛槍充當技術示範，火力配以六磅與十二磅野砲及營屬砲。義軍方面則完全依賴混裝：奧地利韋恩德爾式一八四一年雷管步槍、波蘭騎槍與獵槍在起義者手中流轉，繳獲的普軍六磅砲在索科沃之後才第一次成為義軍的野戰火砲，此外還有農用鋤頭、獵刀與農車改造的簡易器械。雷管槍的射程優勢對缺乏訓練的義軍是雙刃劍：遠距單發精射提高了騷擾的效率，卻讓隊形更易散開，士氣與彈藥消耗同樣難以控制。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card is a French caplock long arm of 1840: the priming composition ignites reliably in rain and mist, which lengthened the range of the weapon, improved accuracy and the hit rate of single shots, and made it better than the old smoothbore flint pieces. The standard infantry arm of the Prussian army was in fact the Dreyse needle gun of 1839, using paper cartridges, credited with an effective range well over two hundred metres and an accuracy far beyond its peers; Pfuel's troops also had percussion muskets and carbines of the 1842 model, a few tube-magazine breechloaders kept for demonstration, and field artillery in six- and twelve-pounder pieces backed by brigade guns. The insurgents were entirely mixed: Austrian Werndl percussion rifles of 1841, Polish carbines and hunting guns passed from hand to hand, and the captured Prussian six-pounders only became insurgent field artillery after Sokołowo; there were also spades, hunting knives and farm carts turned to rough use. The extended range of the percussion rifle was a double edge for troops without drill: aimed single shots at distance improved the efficiency of harassment, but they also pulled formations apart, and morale and ammunition were equally hard to control.
tactics: 起義的第一階段是城市暴動式的街壘戰。二十三日民眾以石塊、推倒的車輛與家具封住街口，普軍巡哨被迫退入城樓與砲台，內城多處落到起義者手中；守方隨後用重砲與工兵反攻，街壘逐段被拆，義軍被擠出城區。轉入鄉村後，義軍採游擊式的小隊行動：步兵散開，藉村莊、樹林與沼澤遮蔽，在四百米至八百米的距離上以雷管槍單發射擊普軍縱隊側面，避開正面的密集火力，打完即退。索科沃與米沃斯托沃兩役的共同做法是夜襲營地或哨位，先以近戰與火槍同時施壓，再奪取砲位與彈藥。普軍的戰術核心是縱隊行軍與搜索清剿：以營為縱隊單位前進，進入村莊後分隊搜索，燒毀可供起義者徵用的糧秣與牲畜，企圖用斷糧取代決戰；同時把騎兵分散用作偵察與通信。進入四月後，米耶羅斯瓦夫斯基改採正規營制與縱隊進攻，但缺砲兵、缺馬匹、缺糧；五月的會戰裡義軍正面承受普軍齊射與騎兵衝鋒而崩解，殘部向南越境。
tacticsEn: The first phase was an urban rising fought with barricades. On 23 January the people blocked the streets with stones, overturned carts and household furniture; Prussian pickets were driven back into the citadel and the batteries, and large parts of the inner city fell into insurgent hands. The garrison answered with heavy guns and engineers, the barricades were taken apart section by section, and the insurgents were squeezed out of the town. In the countryside they switched to small-unit raiding: infantry dispersed, screened by villages, woods and marshes, fired single shots with percussion rifles at four hundred to eight hundred metres into the flank of Prussian columns, avoided set-piece fire fights, and broke off at once after firing. Sokołowo and Miłostowo shared one method: night attacks on camps and pickets, close work and musket fire applied together, and the seizure of gun positions and ammunition. The core of Prussian method was columnar movement and searching: battalions advanced in column, dispersed to search villages on entering them, burned the grain and cattle that the insurgents could requisition, and tried to starve the rising out rather than fight it; the cavalry was dispersed for reconnaissance and for carrying messages. From April Mierosławski adopted regular battalion organisation and attacks in column, but he had no artillery, no horses and no food; in the engagement of May the insurgents faced Prussian volleys and cavalry charges head on and broke, and the survivors crossed to the south.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。起義主爆發於一八四八年一月二十三日，波茲南市內的衝突延續數日；義軍在鄉村接連取得一月二十二日米沃斯托沃與索科沃、一月二十九日至三十日沃爾什廷等勝利，沃爾什廷一役普方分遣隊約一千五百人、砲六門，義軍以相近兵力擊潰之。普軍在二月初投入的兵力已逾一萬，四月自其他省調入數個步兵團，總兵力進入數萬量級；義軍的常規武裝始終在數千人上下，另有數百名外籍志願者參戰。索科沃一役義軍繳獲普軍六磅砲兩門，之後才第一次有了野砲。四月米耶羅斯瓦夫斯基整編的波蘭民族軍約二千至三千人，五月戰敗後越過南部邊境，進入奧地利西里西亞後被解除武裝解散。普軍的調兵主要靠波茲南通往布羅姆堡與柏林的鐵路，義軍的補給則靠農民小車與步行徵發。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The rising broke out on 23 January 1848 and the fighting inside Posen lasted several days; the insurgents scored a series of victories in the countryside, at Miłostowo and Sokołowo on 22 January and at Wolsztyn on 29 and 30 January, where a Prussian detachment of about fifteen hundred men with six guns was routed by a force of comparable size. Prussian strength committed had passed ten thousand by early February, and in April several infantry regiments were brought in from other provinces, so that the total reached a strength of several tens of thousands; the insurgents never had more than a few thousand in regular arms, with several hundred foreign volunteers besides. Two six-pounder field guns were captured at Sokołowo, and only then did the insurgents have field artillery at all. The Polish national army that Mierosławski organised in April numbered about two to three thousand men; after the defeat in May it crossed the southern frontier, was disarmed in Austrian Silesia and dissolved. Prussian reinforcement moved along the railway from Posen through Bromberg towards Berlin, while the insurgents subsisted on peasant carts and on requisition in kind.
cause: 起因是普魯士對大波蘭的統治方式在一八四〇年代持續收緊。一八一五年維也納會議把普魯士持有的波森省包裝成「大波蘭公國」，保留波蘭語在行政、司法與軍隊中的地位，並設有省議會，但教育制度、大學與公職逐步德化，軍隊指揮層德國人居多。一八四七年二月，波森省議會全票駁回波蘭民族提出的一整套請願，包括波蘭語中等學校、波蘭大學、省級自治與讓本省阿爾比尼亞人參與行政，決議送交柏林後被退回，德國化的政策因此不動搖。外部刺激隨之而來：一八四八年二月巴黎推翻路易·菲利普，二月二十二日至二十四日柏林爆發革命並迫使國王承諾言論自由，整個歐洲的舊制度同時出現裂口。波森的學生、律師與一八三〇年舊起義的退伍軍官組成秘密委員會，決定在一八四八年一月二十三日省議會開會時起事。當日下午民眾衝入議會廳與市政廳，攻擊普魯士當局機關，奪取軍械庫，暴動迅速擴為有組織的武裝起義。
causeEn: The cause was the steady tightening of Prussian rule over Greater Poland through the 1840s. The Congress of Vienna in 1815 had packaged the Prussian province as the Grand Duchy of Posen, preserving the use of Polish in administration, justice and the army and providing a provincial diet, but education, the universities and public office were Germanised step by step, and the officer corps was mostly German. In February 1847 the Posen diet rejected the whole set of Polish demands, among them Polish-language secondary schools, a Polish university, provincial autonomy and a share for the local Poles in the administration; the resolution was sent to Berlin and returned, and the Germanising policy therefore stood. The external stimulus followed at once: Paris overthrew Louis Philippe in February 1848, and the Berlin revolution of 22 to 24 February forced the king to promise freedom of the press, so that the old order cracked across Europe at the same moment. Students, lawyers and veterans of the rising of 1830 in Posen formed a secret committee and resolved to rise when the diet met on 23 January 1848. That afternoon the crowd burst into the diet and the town hall, attacked the Prussian authorities and took the arsenal, and the riot quickly became an organised armed rising.
impact: 這場起義雖被鎮壓，其政治後果卻不斷發酵。普魯士在失利後加速取消大波蘭公國的殘餘自治，限制省議會權限，收緊波蘭語教學，一八五〇年代後更隨文化鬥爭進一步收緊，東普魯士與波森的中學教學語言改為德語，波蘭民族運動的重心因此轉向普屬波蘭的地下組織與後來的一八六三年起義。起義失敗後大批波蘭軍官與知識分子流亡，經巴黎、倫敦、維也納與布魯塞爾組成流亡社群，其中不少投入一八四八年三月革命的各國運動；波蘭民族委員會早在一八四七年就設想了以武裝志願兵馳援法國、義大利與匈牙利的波蘭國際軍構想，米耶羅斯瓦夫斯基在西西里組織的波蘭軍團正是此一構想的實踐，並成為一八四九年羅馬共和國階段國際主義的樣板。就德意志內部而言，波森問題也暴露出法蘭克福國民議會的路線矛盾：自由派一方面以民族自決為綱，另一方面仍視波森為德意志邦聯的領土，最終對波蘭人採取維持現狀的立場，這種分裂削弱了國民議會的權威，也把普魯士推向以軍事力量主導德意志統一的道路。
impactEn: Although the rising was suppressed, its political consequences kept unfolding. After the defeat, Prussia hastened to abolish the remaining autonomy of the Grand Duchy, curtailed the powers of the diet, tightened the use of Polish in teaching and, from the 1850s, changed the language of secondary schools in Prussia and Posen to German in the course of the culture struggle; the centre of gravity of the Polish national movement shifted to underground organisation in Prussian Poland and, later, to the rising of 1863. With the failure of the rising, Polish officers and intellectuals went into exile in large numbers and built an émigré community through Paris, London, Vienna and Brussels, many of them joining the revolutionary armies of 1848; the Polish National Committee had conceived a Polish international legion to aid France, Italy and Hungary, and Mierosławski's Polish legion in Sicily was the practical form of that idea and a model for the internationalism of the Roman Republic in 1849. Within Germany the Posen question also exposed the split in the Frankfurt Parliament: the liberals proclaimed national self-determination while still treating Posen as territory of the German Confederation, and the position they finally took was to let the existing arrangements stand. That division weakened the authority of the parliament and pushed Prussia towards taking the lead in German unification by military means.
result: 起義在戰術上有過明確的贏面，在戰略上卻缺乏能承受普軍優勢兵力的結構。一月下旬義軍靠夜襲與散射在鄉村連勝，但未能守住波茲南城；普軍自二月起以縱隊搜索、焚燒徵用物資與逐步增兵取代正面決戰，義軍的糧秣與彈藥供應被逐步掐斷。四月米耶羅斯瓦夫斯基整編出約二千至三千人的波蘭民族軍，一度在米溫德胡德一帶與普軍接戰並奪回部分鄉鎮，但缺砲兵、缺馬匹又缺糧，士氣難以持久。五月普軍主力在兵力與砲火上佔優，義軍在陣地被突破，殘部向南越過邊境進入西里西亞，隨即被奧地利當局解除武裝解散；波蘭民族委員會與國民守衛隊在國內亦被取締，參與者遭到解職、罰款或流放。作為一場以城市暴動起、以鄉村游擊延續、最後在正規會戰中崩解的失敗起義，它留下的最大教訓是：沒有外省援軍、沒有砲兵、沒有一支能作戰的常備軍的城市革命，在對手調來團級部隊與營級砲兵之後，難以維持。雷管步槍在這條脈絡裡的角色相當清楚：它讓義軍得以在遠處精射而保存人命，卻無法取代砲兵、鐵路與後勤所代表的國家戰爭能力。
resultEn: Tactically the rising had its clear moments; strategically it lacked any structure that could bear the weight of Prussian superiority. In the last week of January the insurgents won in the countryside by night attacks and dispersed fire, but they never held the city of Posen. From February the Prussians replaced set-piece battle with columnar searches, the burning of requisitionable supplies and the gradual arrival of reinforcements, and the food and ammunition of the insurgents were throttled by degrees. In April Mierosławski formed a Polish national army of about two to three thousand men, which fought around Międzychód and retook a few villages, but without artillery, horses or food it could not be sustained. In May the Prussians had the advantage in men and in guns, the insurgent line was broken, and the survivors crossed the southern frontier into Silesia, where they were disarmed and dispersed by the Austrian authorities; the National Committee and the National Guard were suppressed at home, and participants were dismissed, fined or exiled. As a rising that began as an urban riot, continued as a rural guerrilla war and collapsed in a set-piece battle, its clearest lesson is that a city revolution without reinforcements from the provinces, without artillery and without a standing army that can fight had no way of holding on once the opponent brought up regimental troops and battalion guns. The role of the percussion rifle in that account is equally clear: it let the insurgents shoot accurately from far off and spare lives, but it could not replace the artillery, the railways and the logistics that stand for the capacity of a state to make war.
